F-SV (Almost) empty spouse rooms[/b][/size][/color]

I made the spouse rooms a bit empty. So everybody can put hers / his own furniture into them.
There is still some stuff on the wall, because it is (right now) NOT possible to put decoration & pictures on selfmade or spouse walls. And I don't wanted to have "bare walls".


[color=#ffe599][size=3][b]Installation:[/b][/size][/color]

- Please copy & paste the default / original spouseRooms.xnb file somewhere save, sure, warm. Feed it good, treat it well.
You will find it in the folder you have installed the game "Stardew Valley". Here look to the Content / MAPS folder. There inside you will find it.

- Take my spouseRooms.xnb and overwrite your default file with mine.

(to uninstall please just overwrite my file with the default file)

[b]Thanks![/b]


[color=#ffff00][b]Update 29.09.2017:[/b][/color] I added an Optional file: "[i]My personal Elliott spouse room[/i]". The other rooms are still the same like in the default file. Only Elliott's room have been changed here. Picture of the changed room have been added, too. It's a stand-alone file.
